# Vendored Browser Flash Dependencies

The host page keeps fixed local copies of the browser flashing dependencies so code with Web Serial access is not fetched from a mutable CDN at runtime.

- `esptool-js 0.5.6`; npm package archive SHA-256: `be8e7f5aecd15bf917255d84990458eda3881b705912f2488a47c4b6de7b6bc0`

Keep the package license files beside each vendored version. When upgrading, replace the complete package output, update the hashes and service-worker asset list, then run the automation host tests.
